title: Sequent-Prover: Training Agents for Formal, Checkable SMT-based Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.15258v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce Sequent-Prover, a family of verifier-using language-model agents, and the post-training framework that produces them. Agents reason in an executable SMT-LIB scratchpad: they write complete SMT-LIB programs, query Z3 across turns, inspect solver feedback, repair formalizations, and terminate with an explicit answer. Our recipe, verifier-conditioned trajectory distillation, bootstraps from a noisy teacher proposal policy by sampling multi-turn trajectories, retaining the successful tail that is correct, non-trivial, grounded, and executable, then applying supervised fine-tuning and trajectory-level preference optimization. Because solver success alone does not guarantee semantic faithfulness, we evaluate task accuracy, k-sample reliability, and SMT program quality. Across 37 benchmarks and 7,254 problems per model family, post-training raises the 4B model's per-attempt accuracy from 85.6% to 97.0% and four-sample all-correct

translated_title: Sequent-Prover：训练用于形式化、可检验的基于SMT推理的智能体
translated_abstract: 我们提出了Sequent-Prover，这是一系列使用验证器的语言模型智能体，以及生成这些智能体的后训练框架。智能体在可执行的SMT-LIB草稿板中进行推理：它们编写完整的SMT-LIB程序，跨多轮查询Z3求解器，检查求解器反馈，修复形式化表示，并以明确的答案结束。我们的方法——验证器条件化的轨迹蒸馏——从带噪声的教师提议策略出发，通过采样多轮轨迹，保留其中正确、非平凡、有据可依且可执行的成功尾部轨迹，随后应用监督微调和轨迹级偏好优化。由于仅凭求解器成功并不能保证语义忠实性，我们评估了任务准确率、k次采样可靠性和SMT程序质量。在37个基准测试和每个模型家族7,254个问题上，后训练将4B模型的单次尝试准确率从85.6%提升至97.0%，并提升了四次采样全对的可靠性（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了Sequent-Prover智能体系列及其后训练框架，通过验证器条件化的轨迹蒸馏方法，让语言模型智能体在可执行的SMT-LIB草稿板环境中进行形式化、可检验的推理，将4B模型在37个基准上的单次尝试准确率从85.6%提升至97.0%。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Sequent-Prover, a family of verifier-using language-model agents trained via verifier-conditioned trajectory distillation to perform formal, checkable SMT-based reasoning in an executable SMT-LIB scratchpad, raising a 4B model's per-attempt accuracy from 85.6% to 97.0% across 37 benchmarks.
